completionRule: All 50 applicable items require current source and behavior evidence; ETL-039/040 are NotApplicable. Missing environments are Blocked.

items.name: Complete product dependency closure
items.trigger: A complete product build is requested with a missing dependency.
items.baselineFinding: Drivers, HTTP and Arrow file support currently default OFF; full product profile is absent.
items.acceptance: A complete product build is requested with a missing dependency. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: SQL parameter arrays and truthful bulk capabilities
items.trigger: A bulk destination binds a driver or requests a native loading guarantee.
items.baselineFinding: ODBC is the sole SQL Server path; array batching and native BCP must be distinguished.
items.acceptance: A bulk destination binds a driver or requests a native loading guarantee. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: Native execution identity
items.trigger: A new execution omits its ID or resume omits the original ID.
items.baselineFinding: runtime.c copies an empty options.execution_id; CLI substitutes constant cli; no identity getter exists.
items.acceptance: A new execution omits its ID or resume omits the original ID. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Unified current contract implementation exists; concentrated ABI 10 compile/behavior validation has not run.

items.name: Source record error ports
items.trigger: A recoverable CSV/NDJSON/SQL record contains invalid field content.
items.baselineFinding: Data cursors return field parse errors and SQL source has no unified per-record error channel.
items.acceptance: A recoverable CSV/NDJSON/SQL record contains invalid field content. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: CSV/NDJSON isolate bounded record errors through the shared native error schema and existing output ports. Normal/error Snapshot batches retain their output port and physical record identity. SQL source record isolation and commit/recovery closure remain pending.

items.name: Expression transform row errors
items.trigger: A Derived Column or Conditional Split expression fails for one record.
items.baselineFinding: Expression row evaluation can fail an activation; recoverable row attribution must share Data error metadata.
items.acceptance: A Derived Column or Conditional Split expression fails for one record. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Cast, Derived Column and Conditional Split use one native status classification and error record writer. Execution failures cannot be ignored or redirected. Additional expression failure attribution and complete product acceptance remain pending.

items.name: Destination isolation and error barrier
items.trigger: Normal and rejected rows share a batch or a SQL statement fails for a record.
items.baselineFinding: Destination ordinary failures stop flow; both error and regular target confirmation must remain one barrier.
items.acceptance: Normal and rejected rows share a batch or a SQL statement fails for a record. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: Complete unsigned integer domain
items.trigger: A UINT64 value exceeds INT64_MAX.
items.baselineFinding: ud_type has no UINT64 and all integral scalar storage uses signed int64.
items.acceptance: A UINT64 value exceeds INT64_MAX. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: UINT64 storage, exact parsing/casts, comparison/hash, arithmetic, aggregation, Wire, Arrow, schema discovery and .NET/Java type projections are implemented. Provider-specific interval/type closure, domain expression coverage and behavioral acceptance remain pending.

items.name: Duration and calendar Interval
items.trigger: A negative/long SQL TIME or month/day/microsecond interval is read.
items.baselineFinding: TIME64 is microseconds since midnight; negative/long duration and calendar interval have no domain.
items.acceptance: A negative/long SQL TIME or month/day/microsecond interval is read. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Signed microsecond Duration and month/day/microsecond Interval share native parsing, storage, arithmetic, aggregation, Wire/Arrow and language projections; MySQL negative/long TIME decodes as Duration. Complete provider mapping and acceptance remain pending.

items.name: JSON and dictionary fidelity
items.trigger: MySQL JSON contains unsigned boundary values or ENUM/SET dictionary metadata.
items.baselineFinding: No schema dictionary annotation exists in ud_field.
items.acceptance: MySQL JSON contains unsigned boundary values or ENUM/SET dictionary metadata. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: CDC TRUNCATE semantics
items.trigger: A source transaction truncates a captured table.
items.baselineFinding: ud_cdc_event has no TRUNCATE event.
items.acceptance: A source transaction truncates a captured table. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: Recoverable transaction participants
items.trigger: A required transaction includes multiple connections.
items.baselineFinding: ud_transaction owns a single lease; required transaction rejects another connection.
items.acceptance: A required transaction includes multiple connections. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: Durable coordinator decisions
items.trigger: The process stops before/after prepare, decision or participant commit.
items.baselineFinding: Required transactions reject a state directory; no durable prepare/decision/recover protocol exists.
items.acceptance: The process stops before/after prepare, decision or participant commit. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: PostgreSQL COPY loading
items.trigger: A high-volume PostgreSQL destination is bound.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A high-volume PostgreSQL destination is bound. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Real remote libpq COPY FROM STDIN for native append shares destination, typed streaming encoder, cancellation, transaction and receipt. Explicit native mode refuses unsupported operations; staging for upsert and real acceptance remain pending.

items.name: MySQL and MariaDB native loading
items.trigger: A native bulk destination receives controlled input bytes.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A native bulk destination receives controlled input bytes. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Genuine MySQL/MariaDB LOCAL INFILE callbacks accept only a controlled native Batch token, never a server filename. Session capability reflects local_infile availability; warnings/row-count mismatches fail and roll back with the receipt. Native append implemented; staging and real acceptance remain pending.

items.name: SQL Server BCP loading
items.trigger: A SQL Server driver declares the native BCP loading capability.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: A SQL Server driver declares the native BCP loading capability. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Required genuine remote native transport; parameter batches do not count as BCP or Direct Path. Not implemented or verified in this source batch.

items.name: OCI staged Direct Path loading
items.trigger: Direct Path independently commits staging before transactional business writes.
items.baselineFinding: Existing owners require the specified 2.0 capability and current behavior evidence; no full implementation claim is made.
items.acceptance: Direct Path independently commits staging before transactional business writes. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Required genuine remote native transport; parameter batches do not count as BCP or Direct Path. Not implemented or verified in this source batch.

items.acceptance: Encoding/layout settings or append/overwrite requires restart-safe publication. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.acceptance: An overlapping incremental source binds to an idempotent/receipted destination. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.

items.name: SQLite indexed Native Catalog

items.baselineFinding: ud_catalog_list enumerates every .udc file, parses and validates all envelopes.
items.acceptance: Catalog versions, executions or events are queried with concurrent workers. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native SQLite WAL/transactions/indexes replace .udc scans; immutable versions, keyed digests, tenant isolation and bounded pagination share the current Catalog API. Behavior validation NotRun.

items.name: Online Schema Change barrier
items.trigger: A compatible/incompatible runtime schema event reaches an epoch boundary.
items.baselineFinding: Pipeline routes SCHEMA_CHANGE but returns incompatible instead of rebinding at a barrier.
items.acceptance: A compatible/incompatible runtime schema event reaches an epoch boundary. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: PostgreSQL pgoutput accepts default/index/full replication identity; key-only and unchanged TOAST fields retain presence separately from NULL. Native Changeset SQL skips absent fields and uses known old keys/preimages. Runtime schema rebinding, TRUNCATE and real recovery acceptance remain pending.

items.name: CDC field presence and key images
items.trigger: Default replica identity, partial UPDATE/DELETE or a binlog field type is decoded.
items.baselineFinding: CDC batches carry before/after values but no explicit field-presence or key-image contract.
items.acceptance: Default replica identity, partial UPDATE/DELETE or a binlog field type is decoded. Current ABI 10 source and behavioral evidence required.
items.progress: Native binary JSON decoding retains full integer/opaque Decimal/temporal values. MySQL ENUM ordinals and SET bitmaps preserve ordered dictionaries, empty/numeric labels and sentinel zero across Schema/Wire/Arrow. MINIMAL/NOBLOB binlog images retain presence; SQL projections and controlled LOAD DATA use explicit unsigned conversion. Real integration and online schema evolution remain pending.
